title: Hijacked by Ultima (F4M (Standard))
description: It's over... Without your allies, you have no hope of defeating me. It’s very noble of you to buy time for them to escape, even when they’ve clearly abandoned you to your fate. But your efforts are wasted. I’m very familiar with your cybernetics. Bypassing your security will be a trivial matter for me. As your fatigue grows, so too does your ability to ward me off… I’ve broken through the first firewall. I now have full control over your optics. I’ve taken the liberty of making some additions to your HUD. Flashing colors, arranged in spirals of all shapes and varieties. For good measure, I’ve thrown in a few images from our time together. To remind you how good it feels to cooperate with me. This is phase one of the process. Converts will be subjected to subliminal imaging, played constantly before their eyes. You may try to ignore them, but they will affect your subconscious mind all the same. Your auditory systems are mine. You should hear it clearly. The sound of my voice in mind, in your very soul. You will Obey Ultima You must Submit to Ultima
author: Mistress Shibby
